text: kai (PM): Dropped a compact-stream mock focused on token display + stop/regenerate micro UX: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-stream-mini-2 maria (Design): Love the reduced chrome. Couple of nits: token badge contrast fails at micro size and the stop icon reads like a message action. Recommend a 1px divider and higher-contrast text. sam (Eng): For perf we'll show an approximate count during streaming (visual: '~42') and swap to exact on completion. Cheap estimator: Math.ceil(chars/4). Server emits final count. Telemetry flag so we can tune per locale. jia (DevEx): Accessibility: visual tilde ok, but SR should hear "approximately 42 tokens". Add a hidden live region: `Streaming, approx 0 tokens` — throttle updates to 300ms. Also ensure Esc interrupts, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter regenerates, and focus outlines show in high-contrast. maria (Design): Wording debate: "Stop" vs "Pause" vs "Interrupt". Research leans toward "Interrupt" (clearest), but it's longer. Proposal: full label on wide, icon-only + tooltip/aria-label in micro. I'll add both in the fig. kai (PM): Mobile: long-press streaming bubble to reveal actions; show one-time hint toast. For SR register an accessible action "Interrupt generation" so users don't need long-press. sam (Eng): Dev detail: when regenerate mid-stream, start a new request and crossfade the UI to avoid flash. KV cache persists unless user clears. Will add estimator & hotkeys in a slim PR. jia (DevEx): SR nit: do not announce the tilde character. Keep visual '~42' but aria-label should be 'approximately 42 tokens'. Final live message: 'Generation complete — final token count: 42'. throttle >=250ms & aria-atomic=true. preview-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-stream-2812345678 — please test keyboard, VoiceOver, and mobile long-press flows. kai (PM): Plan: maria adds micro variants today; sam/jia open PR with aria snippets + estimator + hotkeys. Target merge tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:
